recipes.reason: Restore four alternative methods, which extraction incorrectly concatenated into one cooking sequence.
steps: Choose one of the following four methods.
Method 1: bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Gently add eggs and boil 4–6 minutes (4 for runny yolks, 5 for soft yolks), then remove eggs.
Method 2: bring water to a boil, gently add eggs and boil 1 minute. Remove saucepan from heat, leave eggs in hot water for 5 minutes, then remove eggs.
Method 3: bring water to a rolling boil, gently add eggs, immediately remove pan from heat and cover. Leave 8 minutes, then remove eggs.

Method 4: bring about 1 inch of water to a rolling boil, enough to steam without evaporating completely. Gently add eggs, cover, and boil/steam 6–6½ minutes. Immediately remove pot from heat and drain hot water.
Serve upright in an egg cup or similar holder. Tap the top with a spoon until a spoon-sized area cracks, remove the top, and eat from the shell or dip toast strips into the egg.

recipes.reason: Restore spice paste grouping and omitted assembly and serving procedure.
ingredients: 1 whole chicken with bones or 1 kg chicken parts with bones
4 potatoes, steamed, peeled, and deep fried until golden brown
25 g sohun vermicelli, soaked in hot water 10 minutes
steps: Grind the spice paste ingredients in a food processor. Stir-fry the paste over low heat until fragrant and remove from heat.

Cook chicken with spice paste, galangal, lime leaves, lemongrass, and bay leaves in a pot for at least 30 minutes until tender. A pressure cooker may be used. Traditionally bring soup to a boil, cover, turn off heat, and steep 30–40 minutes.
Add salt or pepper to taste.
Leave chicken in the pot until soup is cool.
Remove meat from bones and slice into tiny bite-sized pieces using fork and knife. Set aside.
Return bones to soup, add sliced green onion, and boil just before serving.
In each bowl layer sliced potatoes, sliced tomatoes, vermicelli, cabbage, bean sprouts, sliced egg, and chicken meat.
Pour boiling soup over the ingredients, keeping bones and chicken skin out of the bowl.
Top with fried shallots and squeeze a slice of lemon over it.
Serve with hot steamed rice or sliced lontong.
